# Implementation Planning Skill

## Must Follow
- Prompt: `.github/prompts/implementation-planning.prompt.md`
- Shared instructions: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Coding standards: `.github/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md`
- Documentation: `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md`

## Tasks
1. Read approved architecture and relevant requirements.
2. Check design review approval and unresolved findings.
3. Break implementation into logical tasks.
4. Map tasks to files and acceptance criteria.
5. Create or update `docs/implementation-plan.md`.
6. Update `docs/agent-reports/implementation-agent-report.md`.

## Rules
- Always update both documents.
- Do not write application code.
- Do not proceed without design approval.
- Complete only after both documents are updated.
